text: きみには　ともだちは　いるかな？

structure.en: do you have any, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end turns a sentence into a soft 'I wonder'. いるかな = 'do you have any, I wonder'.

patterns.name: 〜には〜がいる
patterns.span: きみには　ともだちは　いる
patterns.explanation: A person with に and then いる says that person has someone. きみには　ともだちは　いる = 'you have friends'.
